components.name: autocomplete
components.title: Autocomplete
components.description: A filtering combobox: type to narrow the slotted options, move with the arrow keys, Enter to choose. The chosen value lives in a hidden input (name, wire:model) or bind:value.
components.aria: WAI-ARIA combobox (list autocomplete) with a listbox; the active option is announced through aria-activedescendant.

description.description: Help text (hidden while there is an error).

error.description: Error text; marks the query box invalid.

name.description: Form name of the hidden value input.

value.description: The chosen value. Livewire: wire:model (lands on the hidden input); Svelte: bind:value.

empty.description: "No matches." when the query filters everything out.

invalid.description: On the query box, with an error.

change.blade: input / change on the hidden input (wire:model hears it)

shared: The listbox floats with fixed positioning, so it escapes cards and forms that clip overflow.
livewire: wire:model and every attribute except class and id land on the hidden value input.
svelte: bind:value; other attributes (name, data-*) land on the hidden value input.

components.name: autocomplete.option
components.title: Autocomplete option
components.description: One option of an autocomplete. Its value defaults to its text; label is what the query box shows once it is chosen.

value.description: The value chosen (defaults to the text).

label.description: Text written back into the query box (defaults to the text).

components.name: button
components.title: Button
components.description: The action control: ink fill, outline, ghost and danger variants, a dark-band pair, and a busy state that writes the compass in once an action outlasts a beat. Renders a link when given an href.

variant.description: primary/cta = ink fill; secondary = ink outline; ghost = borderless; danger = red fill; inverse / ghost-inverse = paper fill / hairline outline for dark bands.

loading.description: Busy state. Livewire infers it from wire:click / wire:submit / type="submit" and shows the compass once the action outlasts a beat; true shows it now, false never. Svelte: pass the in-flight flag (loading={form.processing}); the compass appears once it outlasts a beat.

href.description: Renders an <a> with the button look. target="_blank" gets rel="noopener" unless rel is given.

type.description: The native button type. A submit button carries the busy markup automatically.

busy.description: Holds the compass loader shown while busy (only rendered when the button can be busy).

label.description: Wraps the slot when the button can be busy, so the compass can stand in for a leading icon.

loading.description: An action is in flight (set by Livewire, or from the loading prop).

busy.description: The action outlasted a beat; the compass shows.

leadIcon.description: The label starts with an icon, which the compass replaces while busy. Svelte sets it on the client.

disabled.description: Dimmed and inert — except a submitting form's buttons, which keep their ink.

default.description: The label; icons go inline (leading or trailing).

usage.livewire:
<sigta:button variant="cta" href="/book">Book a project <sigta:icon name="arrow-right" size="sm" /></sigta:button>
<sigta:button href="https://calendly.com/sf-sigta/30min" target="_blank">Book a call</sigta:button>
<sigta:button>Preview</sigta:button>
<sigta:button variant="ghost">Cancel</sigta:button>
<sigta:button variant="primary" wire:click="save">Save</sigta:button>   {{-- compass while it saves --}}
usage.svelte:
<Button variant="cta" href="/book">Book a project <Icon name="arrow-right" size="sm" /></Button>
<Button href="https://calendly.com/sf-sigta/30min" target="_blank">Book a call</Button>
<Button>Preview</Button>
<Button variant="ghost">Cancel</Button>
<Button variant="primary" loading={form.processing} onclick={save}>Save</Button>   <!-- compass while it saves -->

shared: Renders <a> when href is set, else <button>. Lifts on hover, settles back onto the paper while pressed, springs back on release.
Use variant="cta" with a trailing arrow-right icon for the main call to action.
On a dark band (bg-inverse) use variant="inverse" and "ghost-inverse" — never override colours.
A link button with target="_blank" gets rel="noopener" unless rel is set.

The label never gives way to the loader: a quick action shows nothing; once one outlasts a beat (--sigta-dur-busy, 500ms) the compass stands in for a leading icon, or is written in before a label that has none. A submitting form's button keeps its ink while it is disabled for the submit. Never write "Saving…" into a button label yourself.
livewire: wire:click / wire:submit / type="submit" add the busy markup and the button takes no clicks while Livewire runs its action (Livewire sets data-loading, on the form for a submit); the runtime shows the compass after a beat.
:loading="true" shows the busy state now (a button you drive yourself); :loading="false" never shows it.
svelte: Pass loading={form.processing} (or any in-flight flag). The busy markup is rendered whenever loading is given or type="submit".
Omit loading for a button that is never busy.

components.name: checkbox
components.title: Checkbox
components.description: A native checkbox whose tick is drawn as two pen strokes. With a label it renders a mono label row; every other attribute lands on the <input>. In a motion list it is the trigger for completing a row.
components.aria: Native <input type="checkbox">; wrapped in its <label> when labelled.

checked.description: Livewire: wire:model or checked; Svelte: bind:checked.

done.description: On a row Sigta.complete() finished: its [data-sigta-strike] text is crossed out.

shared: Use it instead of <input type="checkbox"> with classes. Renders a <label> wrapper when label is set, the bare input otherwise.
The tick is drawn as two pen strokes when checked; the box gives a little under a press.
To complete a row with the full motion (tick, burst, strike, fold), call complete from its change handler in a [data-sigta-motion] list and mark the row's title with data-sigta-strike.
livewire: <sigta:checkbox x-on:change="$sigta.complete($el, () => $wire.complete({{ $task->id }}))" /> — inside Livewire the commit goes out at once and the row folds when the server drops it.
svelte: <Checkbox onchange={(e) => sigta.complete(e.currentTarget, () => remove(task))} /> with out:leave on the row: the row folds, then the item leaves the list.

examples.label: Completing a row in a motion list

components.name: count
components.title: Count
components.description: A number that bumps when it changes — rising as it grows, dropping as it shrinks — whether a morph, an x-text, a Svelte update or a plain write changes it. For unread badges and "12 open" headings. Tabular numerals.
components.aria: A plain <span>; the number is its text.

value.description: The number; falls back to the slot (children) when unset. Zero is a value.

default.description: The number, when value is unset (an x-text target in Alpine).

shared: Use it for a count that changes (unread, open) instead of a bare number in a badge.
The bump is a script animation from the shared core; with reduced motion the number just changes.
livewire: A Livewire morph or an x-text on the count moves it; give the slot the server-rendered number so it reads right before Alpine starts.
svelte: Pass the reactive number as value; the component watches its own text, so any update bumps it.

examples.label: Rises as it grows, drops as it shrinks

components.name: duration
components.title: Duration
components.description: Static duration display in tabular numerals: whole minutes as a compact "1h 15m" (default) or an "HH:MM" clock. Exact hours drop the minutes ("2h"); zero renders "0m".
components.aria: A plain <span>; the duration is its text.

minutes.description: Whole minutes; null and negatives read as 0, fractions are truncated.

format.description: compact (1h 15m) or clock (01:30). Unknown values fall back to compact.

shared: For a value that counts up live use elapsed-clock.
Both runtimes format with the same rules (the core's formatDuration), so a server render and a client render agree.

components.name: elapsed-clock
components.title: Elapsed clock
components.description: Live-ticking HH:MM:SS value counting up from since, in tabular numerals. Presentational — the timer's persistence stays in your app; it cleans up its interval on teardown.
components.aria: A plain <span>; the clock is its text.

since.description: The start instant as an ISO-8601 string; unset means now (the moment it mounts).

blade.note: A Carbon/DateTimeInterface is normalized to ISO-8601.

shared: Server-rendered as 00:00:00; it ticks once a second on the client. A start in the future reads 00:00:00.
For a static duration use duration.
livewire: Pass :since an ISO string or a Carbon/DateTime; omit it for "now".
svelte: Pass since an ISO string (new Date().toISOString(), or what your backend sends).

examples.label: Counting up from a start instant

components.name: field
components.title: Field
components.description: The chrome around a form control: a label, the control, then a description or an error. Every Sigta form control renders through it; wrap a custom control in it yourself.
components.aria: The label points at the control (for); description and error ids are referenced by the control's aria-describedby.

error.description: Error text below the control (replaces nothing; shown in red).

for.description: Id of the control the label names; generated when omitted.

shared: With no label, description, error or attributes it renders the control alone, without a wrapper.
Use it when wrapping a custom control; Sigta form controls already wrap themselves.

components.name: heading
components.title: Heading
components.description: A Fraunces heading at the brand scale. The level picks the tag (h1–h6) and a default size; size overrides the look without changing the outline.
components.aria: Native h1–h6; keep levels in document order and pick the look with size.

size.description: The look; defaults by level (1 → xl, 2 → lg, 3 → base, else sm).

default.description: The heading text; a <sigta:mark> can highlight a word.

shared: Use it instead of styling <h1>–<h6> by hand. The semantic level drives the default size; override the look with size.

components.name: icon
components.title: Icon
components.description: A Lucide icon from the pinned set both runtimes share, at the brand stroke weight (1.75). Decorative unless labelled.
components.aria: aria-hidden by default; pass aria-label and aria-hidden="false" for a meaningful icon.

name.description: Lucide icon name, e.g. arrow-right, check, x, calendar.

shared: Never import another icon library; every icon comes from <sigta:icon> / <Icon>. If an icon is missing from Lucide, say so in a comment rather than substituting another set.
aria-hidden by default; pass aria-label (and aria-hidden="false") for a meaningful icon.

components.name: input
components.title: Input
components.description: A native text input in the field chrome: label, description, error and an optional leading icon. Every other attribute lands on the <input> itself.
components.aria: Native <input>; aria-invalid with an error, aria-describedby for description and error.

error.description: Error text; marks the input invalid.

type.description: Native input type (text, email, password, number, date, …).

value.description: The value. Livewire: wire:model on the component; Svelte: bind:value.

wrap.description: Positions the leading icon (only with icon).

invalid.description: Set with an error: red border until focused.

usage.livewire: <sigta:input label="Email" type="email" icon="mail" wire:model="email" placeholder="you@studio.co" description="We only use this for the invoice." />
usage.svelte: <Input label="Email" type="email" icon="mail" bind:value={email} placeholder="you@studio.co" description="We only use this for the invoice." />

shared: Use it instead of a raw <input>; it wraps itself in the field chrome.
livewire: wire:model (with .live / .blur modifiers) is forwarded onto the native <input>. Under Livewire 4 write wire:model.live.blur for v3-style blur sync.
svelte: bind:value for two-way binding; name, placeholder, required … pass straight through to the <input>.

components.name: label
components.title: Label
components.description: Mono uppercase form label. variant="inverse" re-colours it for a dark surface.
components.aria: Native <label>; point it at its control with for.

variant.description: inverse for a dark surface (inside an inverse panel).

shared: inverse re-colours it for a dark surface (inside <sigta:panel variant="inverse"> / <Panel variant="inverse">).

components.name: loader
components.title: Loader
components.description: The Sigta compass: the brand mark as a loader. While it works the legs swing round and the pencil draws a circle; with a value the circle is drawn as far round as the work has come; done stands the mark complete and stamps; failed shakes it red. Never a generic spinner.
components.aria: role="progressbar" with aria-label (and aria-value* with a value); aria-hidden when decorative.

size.description: xs 16px … xl 72px; small sizes draw a heavier pen.

variant.description: compass turns; sketch draws the whole mark on a loop, for longer waits.

state.description: Unknown values fall back to working.

label.description: Accessible name; defaults to the state (Working, Queued, Done, Failed, Ready).

decorative.description: Hide from assistive tech when a parent already announces the work.

svg.description: The mark; its paths carry the class hooks sigta-loader-frame, -ring(-front/-back), -leg (-needle/-pencil), -arc, -pivot.

progress.description: Present with a value; --sigta-progress carries it.

landing.description: Set by the runtime while a finished compass closes its circle.

usage.livewire:
<sigta:loader />
<sigta:loader size="lg" :value="$import->progress" :state="$import->done ? 'done' : 'working'" />
<sigta:loader variant="sketch" size="xl" label="Preparing your workspace" />
usage.svelte:
<Loader />
<Loader size="lg" value={job.progress} state={job.done ? 'done' : 'working'} />
<Loader variant="sketch" size="xl" label="Preparing your workspace" />

shared: Use it wherever you would write "Loading…" or reach for a spinner.
States: queued (the compass standing, no arc yet, graphite), working, done (the mark complete with its arc and a small stamp), failed (shakes, danger), idle (the complete mark, graphite).

When a working loader turns done, the runtime lets it finish its turn, close the circle and raise it into the mark's arc before the stamp (with reduced motion it lands at once). currentColor throughout.

It never moves. Keep it rendered and change state rather than mounting it per request; if it must be hidden at rest, keep its box with class="invisible". Put it on the side of its text that stays put (after right-aligned text at a right edge) and reserve the text's room so a new word never pushes it.
Prefer save-state, a busy button or job, which hold their space already.
livewire: Never wrap it in @if, x-if, x-show or a bare wire:loading; drive state with a morph or x-bind:data-state. Hidden at rest: class="invisible" wire:loading.class.remove="invisible".
svelte: Never wrap it in {#if}; pass state (and value) from your data.

components.name: modal
components.title: Modal
components.description: A native <dialog> on paper over a blurred ink backdrop: focus trap and Esc for free, an optional heading row with the close button, sizes, and a full-screen sheet for large modals on phones.
components.aria: Native <dialog> opened with showModal(); the close button is labelled "Close".

name.description: Name that triggers and window events address.

heading.description: Heading row text (the close button sits beside it).

dismissible.description: Close button and backdrop click close it.

fullscreen.description: Fill the screen below the tablet breakpoint; defaults to true for lg and xl.

open.description: Svelte: bind:open to open and close it.

dialog.description: The <dialog>; your attributes and class land here.

body.description: Padding and layout around the content.

fullscreen.description: On the dialog: fills the screen on phones.

show.description: Open a modal by name from anywhere.

hide.description: Close a modal by name from anywhere.

shared: Use it instead of custom dialog markup.
Open by name with <sigta:modal.trigger name="…"> / <Modal.Trigger name="…">, or a sigta-modal-show window event { name }; close with modal.close or sigta-modal-hide.
livewire: The dialog carries wire:ignore.self so a Livewire morph inside the modal never closes it. Open from PHP with $this->dispatch('sigta-modal-show', name: '…').
svelte: bind:open is the idiomatic way; the window events work too, so triggers and Livewire-style events behave the same.

components.name: modal.close
components.title: Modal Close
components.description: Closes the modal with the given name (any modal when unnamed) when its content is clicked.

default.description: The clickable content, usually a button.

components.name: modal.trigger
components.title: Modal Trigger
components.description: Opens the modal with the given name (any modal when unnamed) when its content is clicked.

default.description: The clickable content, usually a button.

components.name: money
components.title: Money
components.description: Formats a minor-unit amount (øre/cents) in tabular numerals. Known codes (DKK/EUR/USD/GBP/SEK/NOK) carry symbol, position and separators; override any piece, or pass an unknown code (trailing symbol). suffix renders a muted per-unit tail (e.g. "/ hour").
components.aria: A plain <span>; the amount is its text.

minor.description: The amount in MINOR units (øre / cents); null reads as 0.

currency.description: ISO code; drives symbol, position and separators. Printed upper case in data-currency.

decimals.description: Fraction digits to show (0 for whole-major display; rounds half away from zero).

shared: The amount and currency stay app data: pass minor units and an ISO code, never a preformatted string.
Both runtimes format with the same rules (the core's formatMoney, PHP number_format semantics), so a server render and a client render agree.

components.name: progress
components.title: Progress
components.description: Determinate or indeterminate progress bar: a hairline track filled in ink. A label adds a mono header row with the percentage. Attributes land on the progressbar element itself.
components.aria: role="progressbar" with aria-valuemin/max and aria-valuenow (omitted when indeterminate); aria-labelledby points at the label.

max.description: The value that fills the bar.

label.description: Header text; adds the header row with the rounded percentage.

indeterminate.description: Sweep a short bar across instead of filling; no percentage.

field.description: Stacks the header over the track (only with a label).

fill.description: The ink fill; its width is --sigta-progress (0–100), set inline.

indeterminate.description: On the track: the fill sweeps.

shared: For long-running background work prefer job (or loader with a value), which carry the brand motion; use progress for a plain bar (uploads, steps).
The percentage is value / max, clamped to 0–100.

components.name: text
components.title: Text
components.description: Body copy in Newsreader: the default body, a lede, muted secondary text, a mono caption and a Caveat hand note.

shared:
Use it instead of a

with text utilities. lede = large intro; muted = graphite secondary; caption = small mono; hand = Caveat handwriting.

components.name: toast
components.title: Toast
components.description: The toast region: a fixed stack of paper notes with an inked edge in the variant colour, an optional link or action ("Undo"), dismissed by hand or after a while. Include it once per layout; raise toasts from anywhere.
components.aria: Each toast is role="status" (role="alert" when danger); the dismiss button is labelled.

position.description: Corner of the viewport; bottom ones rise above a visible floating bar.

item.description: One toast (data-variant: success, danger, warning, info).

leaving.description: On an item that was dismissed and is sliding off.

toast.description: Raise a toast: { text, heading?, variant?, duration? (ms, 0 = stay), link? { text, href, target, rel, download, navigate }, action? { text, event, detail } | { text, onClick }, key? (replaces the toast with the same key) }.
toast.blade: sigta-toast (window) — Sigta::toast() from PHP, $sigta.toast() in Alpine, window.Sigta.toast()
toast.svelte: sigta.toast() (import { sigta } from '@sigta-hq/svelte'), window.Sigta.toast(), or the Inertia page prop sigta.toasts

usage.svelte:
<!-- root layout -->
<Toast />

<script>
    import { sigta } from '@sigta-hq/svelte';
    sigta.toast('Your changes have been saved.');
    sigta.toast({ heading: 'Changes saved.', text: 'You can always update this in your settings.', variant: 'success', duration: 5000, link: { text: 'View settings', href: '/settings' } });
</script>

shared: Variants: success, warning, danger, info.

An action (e.g. Undo after a completion) adds a button that fires its event — or runs onClick from JS — and closes the toast. A key replaces the showing toast with the same key instead of stacking another.
Mount it once per layout, near the end of <body>.
Use a key to replace rather than stack (ticking off five items leaves one toast).
livewire: From Alpine: $sigta.toast('Saved') or $sigta.toast({ heading: '…', variant: 'warning' }); from JS: window.Sigta.toast(…); low level: $this->dispatch('sigta-toast', heading: 'Saved', variant: 'success').
action: ['text' => 'Undo', 'event' => 'task-reopen', 'detail' => ['id' => $id]] fires through Livewire, so an #[On('task-reopen')] method receives $id.

From PHP: Sigta::toast('Saved') or Sigta::toast(heading: '…', variant: 'success', action: ['text' => 'Undo', 'event' => 'task-reopen', 'detail' => ['id' => 5]]). An action's event goes through Livewire, so #[On] listeners hear it.
With wire:navigate, wrap it in @persist('toast') so toasts survive page transitions.
svelte: From any backend through Inertia: return { sigta: { toasts: [{ text, variant }] } } in the page props and use the inertia subpath.

components.name: tooltip
components.title: Tooltip
components.description: Ink bubble on hover/focus with a 150ms open delay; Escape dismisses it. The slot (children) is the trigger.
components.aria: The bubble is role="tooltip"; the trigger wrapper points at it with aria-describedby.

position.description: Side of the trigger; unknown values sit on top.

bubble.description: The ink bubble (role="tooltip"), hidden until shown.

position.description: On the root: which side the bubble sits.

shared: Use it instead of a title= attribute or a custom popover.
A tooltip only adds a hint: an icon-only trigger still needs its own aria-label.
